title: Dropbox
need: A Dropbox account; an app key you make (free)

title: Google Drive
need: A Google account; a client ID you make (free)

title: OneDrive
need: A Microsoft account; a client ID you make (free; a personal account needs a free Azure account first)

title: Box
need: A Box account; a client ID and secret you make (free)

title: S3-compatible storage
need: A bucket on Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces or your own server, and an access key

title: Folders in the Files app
need: A folder in iCloud Drive, On My iPhone, a USB drive or another app

title: Cloudflare Access
need: A server behind Cloudflare Zero Trust; optionally a service token
